entry_points.summary: Maps role names to expected contracts: consultant_primary/secondary -> freeform, reviewer -> review-verdict, implementer/ideator/consultant/audit_persona -> None (any). 7 roles total. Single source of truth for known roles.
Resolve persona/model/runtime triple for (command, role) from merged TOML config; emits chimera event when axes come from >=2 layers.
Print JSON array of {name, source_layer, path} -- winner per name only; emits persona_shadowed on collisions.
Validate all bound personas exist, compatible_roles are known, contract matches role expected_contract. Exits 1 on any violation.
Print all layer paths defining a named persona in load order; exits 1 if not found.
Print frontmatter + body of the winning persona file for a given name.

random-for-role <role>: enumerate compatible personas (including boring-anchor), prepend no-persona sentinel, apply --exclude, draw uniformly, emit persona_random_selected. Empty pool -> boring-anchor tagged fallback_empty_pool.

random-distinct-for-role <role> --count=<N>: draw up to N distinct personas without replacement, excluding boring-anchor and no-persona. Graceful underflow. selection_source=random_role_pool_distinct. Backs /z-brainstorm ideator diversity and multi-arm panels.

forced-control <role> [--arm=boring-anchor|no-persona]: return forced-control arm tagged selection_source=forced_control. Emits persona_random_selected. Used on the cadence-Nth attempt as a floor guarantee.
control-counter --increment: atomically read + increment + persist .z-harness/.persona-control-counter (flock-guarded). Returns new integer value.
Emits persona_shadowed once per (process, name) for each name defined in more than one layer.
Emits persona_binding_chimera once per (process, command, role) when persona/model/runtime axes come from >=2 config layers.
Return winning-layer personas compatible with role, excluding explicit exclude_ids. boring-anchor bypasses compatible_roles/contract checks. Filters out any no-persona.md disk file.
String constant 'boring-anchor' -- the control persona. Member of random pool (T102); also drawn on forced-control cadence. fallback_empty_pool draws are quarantined.

String constant 'no-persona' -- the reserved null baseline sentinel. No disk file; persona_body_path=null. Always prepended to random pool unless --excluded. Primary delta baseline in persona-stats.py.
Minimal stdlib-only frontmatter parser shared by all per-target persona_export.py modules. Returns (name, frontmatter_text, body); strips leading blank line from body.
Returns a portability comment block (target, native, description) for exported persona files. Used by all four per-target export adapters.
Export persona to <root>/.agent/personas/<name>.md for Antigravity (agy) target. NATIVE -- agy reads persona files directly from .agent/personas/.
Export persona as .cursor/personas/<name>.mdc context-injection rule for Cursor. NOT NATIVE -- glob attach:'**/*' prepends body as system-prompt prefix.
Export persona to prompts/personas/<name>.md for Codex CLI target. NOT NATIVE -- orchestrator concatenates this file as system-prompt prefix at dispatch time.
Export persona to personas/<name>.md for Claude subagent target. NOT NATIVE -- injected as system-prompt prefix by Claude subagent dispatcher.

Read persona body from body_path, strip frontmatter, prepend to task_prompt with blank-line separator. Returns task_prompt unchanged if body_path is falsy. Called by orchestrator BEFORE Dispatcher.run().

invariants: Persona/model/runtime are orthogonal axes -- persona controls the prompt prefix, model controls which LLM is called, runtime controls the dispatch target. None implies the others.
Layer load order is builtin < user-global < repo-local; last definition wins per name. Shadowing emits persona_shadowed once per (process, name).

_ROLE_REGISTRY contains 7 roles: consultant_primary (freeform), consultant_secondary (freeform), reviewer (review-verdict), implementer (None), ideator (None), consultant (None), audit_persona (None). This is the single source of truth for known roles.

consultant role (contract None): used for 5-panel critique arms in /z-plan and /z-debug AND the measured advisory consult arms in /z-plan-light and /z-audit. Freeform and review-shaped personas both qualify because contract=None means any.

audit_persona role (contract None): one persona drawn per z-audit dimension (correctness/perf/cleanliness/design). Builtin pool of 6; must be >=4 (4 dimensions). Finding-oriented personas are appropriate here.
ideator role (contract None): used by /z-brainstorm for distinct persona diversity across ideator arms. Builtin pool of 8.

random-distinct-for-role is used for multi-arm distinct draws (panels, dimensions) with selection_source=random_role_pool_distinct. random-for-role is used for single-draw advisory arms with selection_source=random_role_pool.

NEUTRAL-AUTHORITY invariant: at every convergent site, the neutral arm is the decision of record. The persona arm is advisory only, logged separately under persona_advisory_recommendation (consults) or reviewer_participant=random_arm (reviewers). No code path merges both into the authoritative decision.
persona_shadowed is de-duped by module-level _shadowed_emitted set keyed on name alone -- fires once per process per shadowed name.
persona_binding_chimera fires when the three binding axes originate from two or more different config layers for the same (command, role) pair; de-duped per (process, command, role).

Contract mismatch between a bound persona contract field and the role expected_contract (from _ROLE_REGISTRY) is a hard error -- cmd_validate exits 1. Personas that omit contract are treated as 'any' and always pass.
Unknown frontmatter keys cause exit 2 -- model/runtime belong in TOML config, not in the persona file. Allowed keys: name, description, compatible_roles, contract.
Persona name must match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$ with no trailing hyphen; validated on frontmatter parse, exits 2 on violation.

Orchestrator (not dispatcher) calls resolve-persona.py, reads persona_body_path, and calls prepend_persona (runtime/dispatch/persona_prompt.py) before Dispatcher.run -- the dispatcher accepts an already-composed prompt and performs no persona resolution internally.

boring-anchor IS a member of the random_role_pool and can be drawn stochastically (T102 amended). The forced_control cadence is a FLOOR guarantee, not the only path. selection_source distinguishes random_role_pool from forced_control.

no-persona is a reserved sentinel (persona_body_path=null). Always prepended to random candidate pool by random-for-role before disk enumeration (unless --excluded). A no-persona draw emits persona_random_selected + persona_attempt_outcome -- it is a tracked baseline arm, NOT the same as knob-off.
_enumerate_role_compatible_personas filters out any disk file named no-persona.md -- only _NO_PERSONA_SENTINEL can produce a no-persona draw.

persona-stats.py resolves the per-stratum delta baseline as: (1) no-persona [primary], (2) boring-anchor [secondary], (3) None [no delta]. fallback_empty_pool draws are quarantined and never enter any baseline.
persona_random_selected is emitted BEFORE the agent runs (at draw time), not at dispatch time. draw_id is the join key between this event and persona_attempt_outcome.

persona_attempt_outcome is emitted by the ORCHESTRATOR at attempt close. True terminals: done, unable_to_complete, abandoned, test_failed, halt. NEVER emitted on needs_clarification, decision_needed, or spec_problem (those are pauses). Only emitted when experiment.persona_rotation=true.
random-distinct-for-role excludes boring-anchor and no-persona from its pool (diversity only, not experiment). random-for-role includes both.
selection_source enum: random_role_pool | random_role_pool_distinct | forced_control | fallback_empty_pool | fixed_panel.

persona_bound extended payload for rotation: adds {run_id, command, role, task_id, attempt_id, persona_id, model, runtime, selection_source, draw_id} plus per-axis source. reviewer events additionally carry reviewer_participant in {base_codex, random_arm}.
attempt_id = <task_id>-v<cycle>. Resume = same cycle -> same attempt_id -> reuse persona-draw.json. Retry = cycle incremented -> new attempt_id -> new draw.
control-counter subcommand increments .z-harness/.persona-control-counter atomically (flock-guarded). Returns new counter value. Called once per fresh implementer attempt.

Per-target export adapters (antigravity/cursor/codex/claude) all call parse_persona_file + build_portability_header from runtime/drivers/_persona_utils.py. Only antigravity is NATIVE -- Cursor/Codex/Claude are workarounds.

Cursor export produces .mdc with alwaysApply:true and glob '**/*'; body becomes rule content. Codex export produces a flat .md with '# Persona: <name>' header. Claude export produces flat .md with frontmatter block preserved. Antigravity export preserves full frontmatter + body.
gotchas: _shadowed_emitted is keyed on name only (not on layer pair), so persona_shadowed fires exactly once per process per shadowed name regardless of how many layers define it.
persona_binding_chimera is keyed on (command, role), not on the specific axis combination -- fires only once per process per (command, role) pair.
boring-anchor bypasses compatible_roles and contract checks in _enumerate_role_compatible_personas -- it enters the pool for any role.
random-distinct-for-role EXCLUDES boring-anchor and no-persona; random-for-role INCLUDES them. Do not confuse the two subcommands.
A no-persona.md file in any layer is silently filtered out by _enumerate_role_compatible_personas -- only the hardcoded _NO_PERSONA_SENTINEL can produce a no-persona draw.
fallback_empty_pool always returns boring-anchor body; this is NOT a forced_control sample and must NOT be counted as boring-anchor baseline in analysis.

prepend_persona (runtime/dispatch/persona_prompt.py) strips YAML frontmatter using body.find('\n---\n', 4); if the closing delimiter is missing, the entire file (including frontmatter) is treated as the body.

Layer 3 (repo-local) path uses git rev-parse to find repo root; falls back to cwd if git is unavailable. Z_HARNESS_REPO_ROOT, Z_HARNESS_REPO_PERSONAS_DIR, Z_HARNESS_BUILTIN_PERSONAS_DIR, and Z_HARNESS_USER_PERSONAS_DIR all override layer paths for hermetic testing.
resolve-persona.sh is a thin bash wrapper -- all logic lives in resolve-persona.py; the shell script exists solely so dispatch sites do not need to know the Python path.

Dispatcher.run() role kwarg is informational only -- it appears in persona_bound but does not trigger any resolution or validation; the caller is already responsible for resolving the role before calling run().
random-for-role exits 2 on unknown role (not in _ROLE_REGISTRY). Add to _ROLE_REGISTRY before calling.
/z-research is intentionally excluded from the persona system -- its three perspectives are fixed semantic lenses, not random draws.

cmd_validate checks compatible_roles entries against known roles in _ROLE_REGISTRY -- a compatible_roles entry for an unknown role is flagged as an error (unlike at random-for-role time which just silently skips it).
persona_advisory_recommendation is logged separately at convergent sites; it NEVER folds into the authoritative decision or synthesis.
reviewer dual-dispatch: both base_codex and random_arm share attempt_id; each has its own draw_id. ONE persona_attempt_outcome per attempt. Analysis groups reviewer rows by reviewer_participant.
parse_persona_file in _persona_utils.py uses stdlib-only regex (_FRONTMATTER_RE) -- no PyYAML dependency. All four per-target export adapters depend on it.

Cursor export uses .mdc extension (not .md); Codex export uses .md with a flat '# Persona:' header (no frontmatter); Claude export preserves the full frontmatter block; Antigravity preserves full frontmatter + body with a portability comment header.
